WITH monthly_baskets AS (
  SELECT
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sales_date)::INTEGER AS month_num,
    (SUM((f.gross_amount - f.discount_amount - f.vat_amount) / fx.eur_rate)) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 0) AS avg_basket_eur
  FROM fact_sales f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = f.store_id
  JOIN fx_rate fx ON fx.rate_date = f.sales_date AND fx.currency = f.currency
  WHERE s.country_code = 'AT'
    AND f.sales_date >= '2024-01-01'
    AND f.sales_date <= '2024-12-31'
    AND NOT f.is_cancelled
    AND NOT s.is_test_store
    AND NOT f.is_return
  GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sales_date)
)
SELECT
  month_num,
  ROUND(avg_basket_eur, 2) AS avg_basket_eur
FROM monthly_baskets
ORDER BY avg_basket_eur ASC, month_num ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH country_sales AS (
  SELECT
    s.country_code,
    SUM((f.gross_amount - f.discount_amount - f.vat_amount) / fx.eur_rate) AS net_sales_eur,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_date) AS trading_days
  FROM fact_sales f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = f.store_id
  JOIN fx_rate fx ON fx.rate_date = f.sales_date AND fx.currency = f.currency
  WHERE NOT f.is_cancelled
    AND NOT s.is_test_store
    AND YEAR(f.sales_date) = 2025
  GROUP BY s.country_code
)
SELECT
  (SELECT net_sales_eur / NULLIF(trading_days, 0) FROM country_sales WHERE country_code = 'HU')
  -
  (SELECT net_sales_eur / NULLIF(trading_days, 0) FROM country_sales WHERE country_code = 'AT')
  AS difference_eur;
assumptions: Calendar year 2025 is used (1 January to 31 December 2025).
Average daily net sales is calculated as net sales divided by trading days (distinct dates with valid sales), not calendar days.
The difference is Hungary's average daily net sales minus Austria's average daily net sales.
Returns are included in net sales as negative lines.
Test stores and cancelled receipts are excluded.

WITH category_shares AS (
  SELECT
    p.category_en,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.is_private_label THEN (f.gross_amount - f.discount_amount - f.vat_amount) / fx.eur_rate ELSE 0 END) AS private_label_net_sales,
    SUM((f.gross_amount - f.discount_amount - f.vat_amount) / fx.eur_rate) AS total_net_sales
  FROM fact_sales f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = f.store_id
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = f.product_id
  JOIN fx_rate fx ON fx.rate_date = f.sales_date AND fx.currency = f.currency
  WHERE NOT f.is_cancelled
    AND NOT s.is_test_store
    AND s.country_code = 'HU'
    AND YEAR(f.sales_date) = 2025
  GROUP BY p.category_en
)
SELECT
  category_en,
  private_label_net_sales / NULLIF(total_net_sales, 0) AS private_label_share
FROM category_shares
WHERE total_net_sales > 0
ORDER BY private_label_share DESC, category_en ASC
LIMIT 1;
assumptions: Calendar year 2025 means 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31.
Private-label share is calculated as the sum of private-label net sales divided by total net sales in EUR, at the category level.
Ties are broken alphabetically by English category name.
Returns are included as negative lines in both numerator and denominator.

WITH fy_sales AS (
  SELECT
    s.country_code,
    d.fiscal_year,
    SUM((f.gross_amount - f.discount_amount - f.vat_amount) / fx.eur_rate) AS net_sales_eur
  FROM fact_sales f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = f.store_id
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.date = f.sales_date
  JOIN fx_rate fx ON fx.rate_date = f.sales_date AND fx.currency = f.currency
  WHERE NOT f.is_cancelled
    AND NOT s.is_test_store
    AND d.fiscal_year IN (2025, 2026)
  GROUP BY s.country_code, d.fiscal_year
)
SELECT
  country_code,
  MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2025 THEN net_sales_eur END) AS fy2025_revenue_eur,
  MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2026 THEN net_sales_eur END) AS fy2026_revenue_eur,
  (MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2026 THEN net_sales_eur END) / NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2025 THEN net_sales_eur END), 0)) - 1 AS fractional_growth
FROM fy_sales
GROUP BY country_code
ORDER BY country_code;
assumptions: Fiscal year 2025 covers 2025-03-01 to 2026-02-28; fiscal year 2026 covers 2026-03-01 to 2027-02-28.
Fiscal year 2026 is incomplete, covering only 2026-03-01 to 2026-10-03 (the last available data date before today 2026-10-04).
Revenue means net sales (gross amount - discount - VAT), converted to EUR using the exchange rate of each sale date.
Cancelled receipts and test stores are excluded.
Fractional growth is calculated as (FY2026 revenue / FY2025 revenue) - 1; a NULL result indicates missing data in the denominator.

WITH fy2025 AS (
  SELECT
    s.country_code,
    SUM((f.gross_amount - f.discount_amount - f.vat_amount) / fx.eur_rate) AS net_sales_eur
  FROM fact_sales f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = f.store_id
  JOIN fx_rate fx ON fx.rate_date = f.sales_date AND fx.currency = f.currency
  WHERE NOT f.is_cancelled
    AND NOT s.is_test_store
    AND f.sales_date >= '2025-03-01'
    AND f.sales_date <= '2026-02-28'
  GROUP BY s.country_code
),
fy2026 AS (
  SELECT
    s.country_code,
    SUM((f.gross_amount - f.discount_amount - f.vat_amount) / fx.eur_rate) AS net_sales_eur
  FROM fact_sales f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = f.store_id
  JOIN fx_rate fx ON fx.rate_date = f.sales_date AND fx.currency = f.currency
  WHERE NOT f.is_cancelled
    AND NOT s.is_test_store
    AND f.sales_date >= '2026-03-01'
    AND f.sales_date <= '2026-10-03'
  GROUP BY s.country_code
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(fy2025.country_code, fy2026.country_code) AS country_code,
  fy2025.net_sales_eur AS net_sales_eur_fy2025,
  fy2026.net_sales_eur AS net_sales_eur_fy2026,
  CASE
    WHEN fy2025.net_sales_eur IS NULL OR fy2025.net_sales_eur = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE (fy2026.net_sales_eur / fy2025.net_sales_eur) - 1
  END AS growth_fraction
FROM fy2025
FULL OUTER JOIN fy2026 ON fy2025.country_code = fy2026.country_code
ORDER BY country_code;
assumptions: A 2025-ös pénzügyi év teljes (2025-03-01 és 2026-02-28).
A 2026-os pénzügyi év hiányos, csak 2026-03-01 és 2026-10-03 közötti adatokkal rendelkezünk (ma 2026-10-04).
A növekedés törtben van kifejezve: (új/régi) - 1.
Nulla vagy hiányzó 2025-ös bevétel esetén a növekedés NULL (nem definiált).
A visszáruk negatív sorokként szerepelnek és csökkentik a nettó árbevételt.

WITH city_baskets AS (
  SELECT
    s.city,
    YEAR(f.sales_date) AS year,
    SUM((f.gross_amount - f.discount_amount - f.vat_amount) / fx.eur_rate) AS net_sales_eur,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipt_count
  FROM fact_sales f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = f.store_id
  JOIN fx_rate fx ON fx.rate_date = f.sales_date AND fx.currency = f.currency
  WHERE NOT f.is_cancelled
    AND NOT s.is_test_store
    AND NOT f.is_return
    AND YEAR(f.sales_date) IN (2024, 2025)
  GROUP BY s.city, YEAR(f.sales_date)
),
baskets_by_year AS (
  SELECT
    city,
    year,
    net_sales_eur / NULLIF(receipt_count, 0) AS avg_basket_eur
  FROM city_baskets
),
basket_comparison AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(b2024.city, b2025.city) AS city,
    COALESCE(b2024.avg_basket_eur, 0) AS basket_2024,
    COALESCE(b2025.avg_basket_eur, 0) AS basket_2025,
    COALESCE(b2025.avg_basket_eur, 0) - COALESCE(b2024.avg_basket_eur, 0) AS increase
  FROM baskets_by_year b2024
  FULL OUTER JOIN baskets_by_year b2025 ON b2024.city = b2025.city AND b2024.year = 2024 AND b2025.year = 2025
)
SELECT
  city,
  ROUND(increase, 2) AS increase_eur
FROM basket_comparison
WHERE basket_2024 IS NOT NULL AND basket_2025 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY increase DESC, city ASC
LIMIT 1;
assumptions: Calendar years 2024 and 2025 are used (not fiscal years).
Average basket is calculated as the sum of net sales in EUR divided by the count of distinct non-return receipts, at the city level for each year.
Only cities with sales data in both 2024 and 2025 are included in the comparison.
Ties in the absolute increase are broken alphabetically by city name.
Test stores and cancelled receipts are excluded; return receipts are excluded from the basket calculation.

  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = f.store_id

WITH units_by_category_year AS (
  SELECT
    p.category_en,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.sales_date) AS year,
    SUM(f.quantity) AS units
  FROM fact_sales f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = f.store_id
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = f.product_id
  WHERE NOT f.is_cancelled
    AND NOT s.is_test_store
    AND NOT f.is_return
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.sales_date) IN (2024, 2025)
  GROUP BY p.category_en, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.sales_date)
)
SELECT
  category_en,
  MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN units END) AS units_2024,
  MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2025 THEN units END) AS units_2025,
  (MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2025 THEN units END) / NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN units END), 0)) - 1 AS fractional_growth
FROM units_by_category_year
GROUP BY category_en
ORDER BY category_en;

WITH monthly_sales AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', f.sales_date)::DATE AS month_start,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sales_date)::INTEGER AS month_num,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.sales_date)::INTEGER AS year_num,
    SUM((f.gross_amount - f.discount_amount - f.vat_amount) / fx.eur_rate) AS net_sales_eur
  FROM fact_sales f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = f.store_id
  JOIN fx_rate fx ON fx.rate_date = f.sales_date AND fx.currency = f.currency
  WHERE s.country_code = 'AT'
    AND NOT f.is_cancelled
    AND NOT s.is_test_store
    AND f.sales_date >= '2025-02-01'
    AND f.sales_date <= '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', f.sales_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sales_date), EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.sales_date)
),
month_changes AS (
  SELECT
    month_num,
    net_sales_eur,
    LAG(net_sales_eur) OVER (ORDER BY year_num, month_num) AS prev_month_sales,
    net_sales_eur - LAG(net_sales_eur) OVER (ORDER BY year_num, month_num) AS mom_change
  FROM monthly_sales
  ORDER BY year_num, month_num
)
SELECT
  month_num,
  mom_change
FROM month_changes
WHERE mom_change IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY mom_change ASC, month_num ASC
LIMIT 1;
assumptions: Calendar months are used (February through December 2025), not fiscal months.
Month-on-month change is calculated as current month net sales minus previous month net sales.
The largest drop is the most negative (smallest) value.
Ties are broken by selecting the earlier month (lower month number).
Austria is identified by country_code = 'AT'.
Cancelled receipts and test stores are excluded.

Közös kereskedési napok: olyan dátumok, amikor mindkét országban volt értékesítés

  COALESCE(fy2026_ytd.net_sales_eur, 0) - COALESCE(fy2025.net_sales_eur, 0) AS absolute_change_eur,
  CASE

  END AS relative_growth
FROM fy2025

  SELECT 
    s.country_code,

  JOIN fx_rate fx ON fx.rate_date = f.sales_date AND fx.currency = f.currency

WITH monthly_sales AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', f.sales_date)::DATE AS month_start,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sales_date)::INTEGER AS month_num,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.sales_date)::INTEGER AS year_num,
    SUM((f.gross_amount - f.discount_amount - f.vat_amount) / fx.eur_rate) AS net_sales_eur
  FROM fact_sales f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = f.store_id
  JOIN fx_rate fx ON fx.rate_date = f.sales_date AND fx.currency = f.currency
  WHERE s.country_code = 'AT'
    AND NOT f.is_cancelled
    AND NOT s.is_test_store
    AND f.sales_date >= '2025-02-01'
    AND f.sales_date <= '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', f.sales_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sales_date), EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.sales_date)
),
month_changes AS (
  SELECT
    month_num,
    net_sales_eur,
    LAG(net_sales_eur) OVER (ORDER BY year_num, month_num) AS prev_month_sales,
    net_sales_eur - LAG(net_sales_eur) OVER (ORDER BY year_num, month_num) AS mom_change
  FROM monthly_sales
  ORDER BY year_num, month_num

ORDER BY mom_change ASC, month_num ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH receipt_lines AS (
  SELECT
    f.receipt_id,
    f.line_no,
    (f.gross_amount - f.discount_amount - f.vat_amount) / fx.eur_rate AS net_value_eur,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.receipt_id ORDER BY (f.gross_amount - f.discount_amount - f.vat_amount) / fx.eur_rate DESC) AS rn
  FROM fact_sales f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = f.store_id
  JOIN fx_rate fx ON fx.rate_date = f.sales_date AND fx.currency = f.currency
  WHERE s.country_code = 'HU'
    AND YEAR(f.sales_date) = 2025
    AND NOT f.is_return
    AND NOT f.is_cancelled
    AND NOT s.is_test_store
)
SELECT AVG(net_value_eur) AS mean_highest_line_value_eur
FROM receipt_lines
WHERE rn = 1;
assumptions: Calendar year 2025 (1 January - 31 December 2025) is used, not fiscal year.
Non-return receipts are included; return receipts are excluded.
Cancelled receipts and test stores are excluded.
The highest-net-value line per receipt is identified by the maximum net value in EUR (gross - discount - VAT, divided by the exchange rate of the sale date).
When multiple lines on a receipt have the same maximum net value, the first one by line number is selected as the tie-breaker.
The result is the arithmetic mean of the highest line values across all qualifying receipts.

WITH monthly_sales AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', f.sales_date)::DATE AS month_start,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sales_date)::INTEGER AS month_num,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.sales_date)::INTEGER AS year_num,
    SUM((f.gross_amount - f.discount_amount - f.vat_amount) / fx.eur_rate) AS net_sales_eur
  FROM fact_sales f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = f.store_id
  JOIN fx_rate fx ON fx.rate_date = f.sales_date AND fx.currency = f.currency
  WHERE s.country_code = 'AT'
    AND NOT f.is_cancelled
    AND NOT s.is_test_store
    AND f.sales_date >= '2025-02-01'
    AND f.sales_date <= '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', f.sales_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sales_date), EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.sales_date)
),
month_changes AS (
  SELECT
    month_num,
    net_sales_eur,
    LAG(net_sales_eur) OVER (ORDER BY year_num, month_num) AS prev_month_sales,
    net_sales_eur - LAG(net_sales_eur) OVER (ORDER BY year_num, month_num) AS mom_change
  FROM monthly_sales
  ORDER BY year_num, month_num
)
SELECT
  month_num,
  mom_change
FROM month_changes
WHERE mom_change IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY mom_change ASC, month_num ASC
LIMIT 1;
assumptions: Calendar months are used (February through December 2025), not fiscal months.
Month-on-month change is calculated as current month net sales minus previous month net sales.
The largest drop is the most negative (smallest) value.
Ties are broken by selecting the earlier month (lower month number).
Austria is identified by country_code = 'AT'.
Cancelled receipts and test stores are excluded.

monthly_with_change AS (
  SELECT
    month_num,
    net_sales_eur,
    LAG(net_sales_eur) OVER (ORDER BY month_num) AS prev_month_sales,

    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN is_private_label THEN net_sales_eur ELSE 0 END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_private_label THEN net_sales_eur ELSE 0 END), 0) AS difference
  FROM sales_by_year_country_label
  GROUP BY country_code, year
)
SELECT
  country_code,
  MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN difference END) AS difference_2024,
  MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2025 THEN difference END) AS difference_2025,
  MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2025 THEN difference END) - MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN difference END) AS change
FROM pivoted
GROUP BY country_code
ORDER BY country_code;

WITH fy2025 AS (
  SELECT
    s.region_name,
    SUM((f.gross_amount - f.discount_amount - f.vat_amount) / fx.eur_rate) AS net_sales_eur
  FROM fact_sales f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = f.store_id
  JOIN fx_rate fx ON fx.rate_date = f.sales_date AND fx.currency = f.currency
  WHERE NOT f.is_cancelled
    AND NOT s.is_test_store
    AND f.sales_date >= '2025-03-01'
    AND f.sales_date <= '2026-02-28'
  GROUP BY s.region_name
),
fy2026_ytd AS (
  SELECT
    s.region_name,
    SUM((f.gross_amount - f.discount_amount - f.vat_amount) / fx.eur_rate) AS net_sales_eur
  FROM fact_sales f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = f.store_id
  JOIN fx_rate fx ON fx.rate_date = f.sales_date AND fx.currency = f.currency
  WHERE NOT f.is_cancelled
    AND NOT s.is_test_store
    AND f.sales_date >= '2026-03-01'
    AND f.sales_date <= '2026-10-03'
  GROUP BY s.region_name
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(fy2025.region_name, fy2026_ytd.region_name) AS region_name,
  COALESCE(fy2025.net_sales_eur, 0) AS net_sales_fy2025,
  COALESCE(fy2026_ytd.net_sales_eur, 0) AS net_sales_fy2026_ytd,
  COALESCE(fy2026_ytd.net_sales_eur, 0) - COALESCE(fy2025.net_sales_eur, 0) AS absolute_change_eur,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(fy2025.net_sales_eur, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE (COALESCE(fy2026_ytd.net_sales_eur, 0) / COALESCE(fy2025.net_sales_eur, 0)) - 1
  END AS relative_growth
FROM fy2025
FULL OUTER JOIN fy2026_ytd ON fy2025.region_name = fy2026_ytd.region_name
ORDER BY relative_growth DESC NULLS LAST, absolute_change_eur DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

    s.region_name,
    SUM((f.gross_amount - f.discount_amount - f.vat_amount) / fx.eur_rate) AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = f.store_id

  WHERE NOT f.is_cancelled

    AND f.sales_date <= '2025-10-03'

SELECT
  c.region_name,
  c.net_sales AS current_net_sales_eur,
  p.net_sales AS previous_net_sales_eur,
  (c.net_sales / NULLIF(p.net_sales, 0)) - 1 AS relative_growth

SELECT
  CASE WHEN h.holiday_date IS NOT NULL THEN 'Holiday' ELSE 'Non-Holiday' END AS day_type,
  h.holiday_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_date) AS trading_days,
  SUM((f.gross_amount - f.discount_amount - f.vat_amount) / fx.eur_rate) AS net_sales_eur,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipt_count,
  SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold,
  (SUM((f.gross_amount - f.discount_amount - f.vat_amount) / fx.eur_rate)) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 0) AS avg_basket_eur
FROM fact_sales f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = f.store_id
JOIN fx_rate fx ON fx.rate_date = f.sales_date AND fx.currency = f.currency
LEFT JOIN dim_holiday h ON h.country_code = s.country_code AND h.holiday_date = f.sales_date
WHERE NOT f.is_cancelled
  AND NOT s.is_test_store
  AND NOT f.is_return
GROUP BY CASE WHEN h.holiday_date IS NOT NULL THEN 'Holiday' ELSE 'Non-Holiday' END, h.holiday_name
ORDER BY day_type DESC, h.holiday_name;
assumptions: Public holidays are identified by joining fact_sales dates with dim_holiday using country code and date.
Return receipts are excluded from all metrics (NOT f.is_return).
Cancelled receipts and test stores are excluded (NOT f.is_cancelled AND NOT s.is_test_store).
Average basket is calculated as the ratio of net sales to receipt count at the holiday/non-holiday level.
Trading days are counted as distinct dates with valid sales for each category.
Stores have no sales rows on public holidays, so holiday rows represent dates when stores were closed; the result will show non-holiday data only, with NULL holiday_name for regular trading days.

WITH holiday_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    h.holiday_date,
    h.holiday_name,
    h.country_code,
    COALESCE(SUM((f.gross_amount - f.discount_amount - f.vat_amount) / fx.eur_rate), 0) AS holiday_net_sales_eur
  FROM dim_holiday h
  LEFT JOIN fact_sales f ON f.sales_date = h.holiday_date
  LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = f.store_id AND s.country_code = h.country_code
  LEFT JOIN fx_rate fx ON fx.rate_date = f.sales_date AND fx.currency = f.currency
  WHERE NOT (f.is_cancelled OR s.is_test_store) OR f.sales_date IS NULL
  GROUP BY h.holiday_date, h.holiday_name, h.country_code
),
regular_day_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    s.country_code,
    SUM((f.gross_amount - f.discount_amount - f.vat_amount) / fx.eur_rate) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_date), 0) AS avg_daily_net_sales_eur
  FROM fact_sales f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = f.store_id
  JOIN fx_rate fx ON fx.rate_date = f.sales_date AND fx.currency = f.currency
  WHERE NOT f.is_cancelled AND NOT s.is_test_store
    AND f.sales_date NOT IN (SELECT holiday_date FROM dim_holiday WHERE country_code = s.country_code)
  GROUP BY s.country_code
)
SELECT 
  h.holiday_date,
  h.holiday_name,
  h.country_code,
  h.holiday_net_sales_eur,
  r.avg_daily_net_sales_eur,
  CASE 
    WHEN r.avg_daily_net_sales_eur > 0 THEN (h.holiday_net_sales_eur / r.avg_daily_net_sales_eur - 1) * 100
    ELSE NULL
  END AS forgalom_valtozas_szazalek
FROM holiday_sales h
LEFT JOIN regular_day_avg r ON r.country_code = h.country_code
ORDER BY h.country_code, h.holiday_date;
